title: Great tour and great guide
text:
Great tour and awesome tour guide (shout out to Papa Bear!). He was informative, personable, and got us there and back safely. Getting to squeeze in a trip to France was definitely a bonus. 

Girona was beautiful and we enjoyed hearing the history. Collioure was lovely as well!
author: Lena_L

title: 2 Countries with Tony!!!
text: Antoine(Tony) was the best guide ever!!!! The tour, yes it was long, but totally wonderful.  Highly recommend Tony and this tour.
author: DARIA403

title: 2 countries
text: Tony was a very informative guide.  We discussed about different sites and history on our way to France and back to Barcelona
author: Doug_S

title: Perfect day
text: Guillermo was a very informative guide, and our day was absolutely perfect from start to finish. We traveled with six other folks in an extremely comfortable van and headed through the Pyrenees to Collioure first. When I picture a French seaside town this is exactly what I had in mind. We had a couple of hours to wander around, shop, have some lunch and wander some more. Very walkable and views were amazing. For those who wanted, there’s a small beach and you can take a dip in the Mediterranean! We headed back towards Barcelona and made our next stop in Girona. Another absolutely beautiful are
author: Judi_K

title: Two Countries Awesome Tour of Girona and Coullier
text: This tour experience was great, informative, beautiful, and fun. Our guide GUIDI was excellent!!! The pastries in Girona and the lunch by the Mediterranean seaside were the highlights.
author: Gregory_B

title: Collioure/Girona Trip
text: We had a great guide for our trip. His name was Antonio (Tony). First of all he picked us up on time.He was very professional but also very informative and friendly at the same time. He took us to Collioure, France and Girona, Spain. They were both nice but Collioure was our groups favorite place. It was a beautiful little village with picturesque scenery. We would go there again if given the opportunity. We would also love to have Antonio (Tony) as a guide again he was fantastic.
author: Michael_F

title: Awesome trip
text: Our tour  guide was great Papa Bear was very informative and nice I would request him again. France had a beautiful view and great food.
author: Marisela_N

title: Awesome experience!!!
text: Family of five had a wonderful time with Papa Bear in Spain and France.  He's the best guide we've had out of the six we spent time with this week. Very knowledgeable and friendly.  We highly recommend him for your tour.
author: Frank_N

title: We covred Madrid, Seville...
text:

title: Incredible
text: Awesome tour! Our guide Tony was extremely knowledgeable and provided a lot of good information and context and made us want to come back to explore even more. The tour was beautiful. I highly recommend it.
